era: 2019 Trustpilot (the June 2018 Venturethree rebrand, unchanged through 2019 for every visitor): navy #000032 72px header with the white star logo, Categories / Log in / Sign up and an outlined 'For companies' button; photo hero with a white bold 'Behind every review is an experience that matters' / 'Read reviews. Write reviews. Find companies.' and a white search box with a square green Search button; white 4px-radius cards on a #f2f2f5 page; Helvetica. No blob shapes, no AI features, no business promos on the home page.

sources.shows: launch article for the 2018 identity used through 2019: navy header, green star, phone mockup of the consumer home 'Behind every review is an experience that matters' with search field and green search button
the 2018 logo and site mockups (business site, laptop and tablet)
